text:
Maya (CS): kicking off Tessera onboarding — quick sync on owners, success criteria, and any renewal flags. can everyone confirm availability for a 30m kickoff tomorrow?
Carlos (SE): available 10:30-11:30 PST. will own infra touchpoints (VPC, KMS).
Laura (PM): I can do 11:00 PST. I'll own success criteria + pilot scope.
Sam (Eng): 11:00 PST works. i'll bring runtime/latency baseline and a test plan.
Riley (CSM): tagging renewal lead — Tessera is enterprise pilot w/possible expansion in Q4. renewal risk: moderate if they don't hit latency SLA in pilot.
Maya (CS): noted @Riley — let's add measurable targets: 95th pct latency < 300ms for 1k qps sim; cost/unit < $0.02/token for embed-heavy flows.
Carlos (SE): need to confirm their network egress policy. Tessera VPN uses IP allowlist; request: provide static egress IPs.
Laura (PM): success checklist draft (WIP):
```
- baseline perf run completed
- end-to-end integration w/ auth + audit logs
- canary traffic at 5% for 48h
- enablement session for devs + docs handed off
- feedback capture form + weekly health sync
```
Maya (CS): can we add a renewal checkpoint after 30 days of pilot with usage threshold 75% of committed capacity? if they fall below, risk review.
Riley (CSM): yes. also ask for customer NPS after integration and collect 2 example prompts for quality evals.
Sam (Eng): for the perf run i'll need model name & sequence distribution from Tessera — @Carlos can share the template I'll ingest.
Carlos (SE): sharing template now: https://redwood.internal/templates/onboard-infra.csv (will DM creds)
calendar-bot: Meeting created: Tessera Onboarding Kickoff — 2026-05-12 11:00 PST — attendees: Maya, Carlos, Laura, Sam, Riley
Maya (CS): main owners: Maya (CS) — onboarding cadence, Laura (PM) — success criteria, Carlos (SE) — infra, Sam (Eng) — runtime. Riley will track renewal signals.
Laura (PM): deliverables before kickoff: customer send model profile + example traffic; internal: perf harness + cost-estimator. I'll add to the doc and ping Eve in sales for account context.
Riley (CSM): I'll prep renewal health rubric and capture any procurement timelines.
Maya (CS): risk notes: data residency question from legal — Tessera asked about EU-only logs. if true, need private deployment path.
Carlos (SE): if EU-only, will require Dedicated or Private — I'll prep config options.
Maya (CS): ok team — last ask: add one page 'what success looks like' for customer-facing kickoff. Laura can you draft?
Laura (PM): yes, i'll draft and post by EOD.
Sam (Eng): i'll attach perf script and a simple runbook to the doc.
Maya (CS): thanks. closing with next actions: 1) Tessera to send model & traffic sample, 2) internal perf harness ready, 3) kickoff calendar invite tomorrow 11:00 PST.
Carlos (SE): lgtm :thumbsup:
Riley (CSM): adding weekly sync cadence to calendar post-kickoff.
Maya (CS): great — see you all tomorrow.
